trap.label: for × since
trap.wrong: By winter they will have been trading since a year.
trap.right: By winter they will have been trading for a year.
trap.why: Em português “há um ano” e “desde” se confundem. Em inglês, for + duração; since + ponto de início.

mcq.q: “They will have been trading ___ a year.”

fix.wrong: By May we will have been negotiating since six months.
fix.right: By May we will have been negotiating for six months.

fix.wrong: They will have trade for a year.
fix.right: They will have been trading for a year.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva em Future Perfect Continuous: “By winter they trade for a year.”
rewrite.answer: By winter they will have been trading for a year.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com for: “since two years” → “___ two years”
Reescreva com give rise to: “Thin mandates caused mistrust.”
rewrite.answer: Thin mandates gave rise to mistrust.
